A '''gondola skimmersub''' was an aquatic vehicle used in [[Bartyn's Landing]], a coastal town of [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. It was developed by local [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] engineers looking for a means to move through either surface and the lower levels of [[The Ring (district)|The Ring]] district.

A gondola skimmersub was similar to a Gungan [[bongo]], with a fish-like central fin, a central sail that collapsed when diving, hydrojets to maneuver underwater and smaller repulsorsails both in port and starboard sides. It had [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] windows and could reach a maximum depth of 500 meters. Unlike the bongo, the gondola skimmersub could not use the [[locab plasma]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

As of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], most families in Bartyn's Landing owned one of these.

This vehicle might have some relation with the [[subskimmer]]s available for rent at [[Ackrahbala's Swoops & Speeders]].
